# install-cann-release

[中文手册](../../../docs/zh/actions/install-cann-release.md) · [English guide](../../../docs/en/actions/install-cann-release.md)

解析正式发布镜像中的最新语义版本，在 CATLASS host 安装 Toolkit 与匹配的 ops 到 `/opt/cann/<version>`。

Resolves the newest semantic version in the release mirror and installs Toolkit plus matching ops on a CATLASS host under `/opt/cann/<version>`.
